summary: Russell's Studio Phase 2 tested end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases passed (voiceover MP3 sync, image-card PNG sync, all 3 hero-clip validation guards for duration/model/square-on-sora-2, Sora 2 hero render 4s portrait completed within ~60s with .mp4 output > 100kB, ffmpeg assemble produced final .mp4 downloadable at 200/video/mp4, jobs list includes both created jobs). Frontend: full /studio pipeline ran green with all data-testids present — 'espresso martini' ideas → click first → TikTok tab → Write the script (2756 chars, includes '## SPOKEN SCRIPT') → Save voiceover appears audio element → Render hero clip button flipped to 'Sora is cooking... (rendering)' and hero video appeared at ~60s → Assemble MP4 produced final-video + download link at ~20s. Sora completed on the whisky-pour prompt first try (no safety-retry needed). No 502s, no ingress issues, no console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: studio.py monkey-patches OpenAIVideoGeneration.SIZES on every Sora call. Works, but a one-time patch at import time (module level) would be cleaner and cheaper.
assemble endpoint calls _media_path even when outro_image_filename is None but the empty-string branch is fine — no bug, just noting the ternary catches both.
generated/studio/ has no size cap or retention policy. On a busy day this dir will fill the container disk. Recommend a background sweeper or per-user quota.
hero-clip params 'aspect' and 'duration' are validated via 400s but 'prompt' > 4000 chars is not truncated (voiceover truncates). Consider aligning behaviour.
GET /studio/media/{filename} sanitises via basename which prevents traversal — good; no auth on media though, which is fine for public preview usage but note it's world-readable.
test_credentials: n/a — Studio has no auth gating
seed_data_creation: Generated 1 voiceover mp3, 1 image-card png, 1 Sora hero-clip mp4, 1 assembled final mp4 under /app/backend/generated/studio/. These are pipeline artifacts, safe to keep or purge.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 fully green. Backend Sora call is ~60s for a 4s portrait clip using sora-2. When retesting UI, prefer 4s duration to keep runs fast. If a hero prompt gets safety-refused, the router surfaces status=failed with error text — the FE toast will show it and a retry with a benign prompt like 'a still life of a rocks glass with amber liquid, cinematic' clears it.
rca of the issue: n/a — no defects found this iteration.
